tools.name: ping
tools.description: Simple ping tool to test server responsiveness and prevent timeouts.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Health check to verify server connectivity and status.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Get current weather for a city.

tools.name: get_current_weather_tool
tools.description:
Get current weather information for a specific city.

    Args:
        city: Name of the city to get weather for

    Returns:
        Current weather data including temperature, conditions, humidity, wind, etc.

tools.name: get_weather_forecast_tool
tools.description:
Get weather forecast for a specific city.

    Args:
        city: Name of the city to get forecast for
        days: Number of days to forecast (1-10, default: 3)

    Returns:
        Weather forecast data for the specified number of days

tools.name: search_locations_tool
tools.description:
Search for locations by name.

    Args:
        query: Location name or partial name to search for

    Returns:
        List of matching locations with their details

tools.name: get_live_temp
tools.description:
Legacy tool: Get current temperature for a city (for backward compatibility).
    Use get_current_weather_tool for more detailed information.
